So, a lot of people shit all over Diamondback, and maybe that's a little deserved, as they did spend some amount of time licensing their brand out to shitty manufacturers. But that era is over, and it seems like DB is back to making solid, quality bikes again.

They're also standing behind their bikes. I managed to crack my 2013 Overdrive frame, and I contacted DB expecting to be told "well you broke it, sorry". But much to my surprise, they were extremely helpful, and happy to make me whole. A new bike is on its way to me right now. That's right - not just a new frame. They have sent me a brand new 2015 model, like for like, and are letting me keep the old one.

I have to say that I am pretty impressed by that. I am happy to see Diamondback stand behind their products. Can't wait for my new bike to come, so I can tear it down and swap my upgraded parts over and get back out there.

I would like to set my own subverses to populate the latest posts at the top, how do I do this? I'll try to answer this as best as I can. It's an algorithm issue because the default sort algorithm will sort most posts with upvoats higher than new non-upvoated posts. If you want to see the latest posts click the "New" button.

Ideas have been brought up talking about possibly using different default sort algorithm for certain subs, one being a blog like behavior, where posts are sorted by date posted, not up/down voats (which is what the new sort essentially does).

Unfortunately right now I don't know what can be done to accomplish what you are looking for other than user participation.
